OST-leverantören innehåller 30 % av utta: The OST provider withholds 30% of the taxable gain portion of withdrawals. Enter the amount already withheld or paid on earlier withdrawals so it is credited and not charged again. Final tax depends on total capital income for the year.
Finland 2026: uttag fördelas proportione: Finland 2026: withdrawals are divided proportionally between gains and remaining contributed capital. Only the capital portion restores deposit capacity under the EUR 100,000 limit. Losses are deductible only on explicit closure. Taxable withdrawals are combined with the owner’s annual capital income.
label: Osakesäästötili (OST)
Ange den skattepliktiga vinstandelen av: Enter the taxable gain portion of previous withdrawals, excluding the returned principal. Enter the remaining contributed capital separately.
